exposure: Inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis)
cohort: 364,363 singleton pregnancies in England between 1997 and 2012, including 1969 pregnancies in women with IBD
finding: Women with Crohn's disease had increased risks of preterm birth, low birth weight, and postpartum hemorrhage, independent of caesarean section, while women with ulcerative colitis only showed an increased risk of preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women with IBD were more likely to have an elective caesarean section.
